name: Sealing Art: Curse of the Prey

system.description:
You attempt to impose the qualities of a single weak bestial creature. Select one creature within your reach. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, they gain one of the following bestial qualities.

Swallows Endurance: The creatures bones begin to feel hollow and brittle as their heart begins to beat furiously as their blood begins to thin. For the duration, they have a -2 penalty on all constitution saving throws, skill checks and ability checks. Additionally, they cannot take the Dash Action and cannot gain additional speed by any means.

Mites Strength: The creatures muscles begin to grow weak and unable to carry weight. They gain a -2 Penalty to their Strength saving throws and melee attacks made.

Sloth’s Grace: The creatures reflexes are shot as they become unable to move gracefully or even carry themselves correctly. They gain a -2 penalty to their Dexterity saving throws and ability checks and ranged attacks made. They also spend their full movement standing from Prone.

Rhinoceros Splendor: The creatures vision, auditory perception and sense of smell becomes dull and weak as they gain a -2 Penalty to their Wisdom ability checks and saving throws. Their visual range is cut in half and they cannot hear things more than 30 feet away from them.

Turkey’s Cunning: The creatures ability to think through complex matters and concepts becomes muddled. They find it hard to remember simple Hand Seals, colors and even their left from their right. They gain a -2 Penalty to their intelligence saving throws and ability checks. They cannot concentrate on more than 1 Jutsu, and the Base Concentration check DC becomes 17.
